title: Two Fruits
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 48.65 Linked Discourses 48.65
  • 7. Bodhipakkhiyavagga 7. On the Side of Awakening

Paṭhamaphalasutta Two Fruits

“Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. “Mendicants, there are these five faculties. Katamāni pañca? What five? Saddhindriyaṁ …pe… paññindriyaṁ—The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyāni. These are the five faculties.

Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā dvinnaṁ phalānaṁ aññataraṁ phalaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—Because of developing and cultivating these five faculties, one of two results can be expected: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti. enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”

Pañcamaṁ.
